explication: This repository is a hands-on Terraform-with-AWS video course, not a single deployable product. The learner’s workflow is to follow lessons in sequence, study each lesson’s README and task, then apply concepts in code samples and projects. Its curriculum progresses from Terraform foundations to AWS resource projects and advanced infrastructure and deployment practices. Representative runtime examples include a three-tier goals application and an image-processing Lambda with monitoring. The map reflects the README curriculum and sampled source; most lesson implementations were not inspected, so their internal connections are not asserted.
